verdict.rationale: HMRC publishes that an agent may act for you: an agent can sign you up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, with its own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links. That is a single thin statement of delegated scope, not a full published map of permitted and prohibited agent actions. missing for 10: published authorisation forms, defined agent roles or permission levels, an explicit list of what agents may not do, which declarations or signatures must remain personal, and independent corroboration.
